finalVerdicts.lens: Glossary compliance: every glossary-listed en term renders with its mandated es term; no forbidden variants anywhere
Register: usted, imperative for instructions, <=6th-grade reading level, phone-screen concision for labels/buttons
Regional neutrality: no Iberian forms, no country slang, no terms with divergent LatAm meanings
Mechanics: {var} sets identical to English per key; .one/.other plural pairs complete and grammatical; no truncated or empty values; punctuation/casing consistent with English intent
Safety accuracy (blind back-translation diff: negation flips, dropped conditions, softened imperatives, ambiguity under stress)

blocked.reason: "Entendido" violates the binding register rule that buttons and menus use the infinitive (es-419 convention; imperative is reserved for instructions/alarms). It is a past participle meaning "Understood", and its only consumer is the close button on sync toasts (src/components/SyncToast.tsx:61, aria-label) — including persistent sync-failure toasts — so it mislabels a dismiss action as an acknowledgment of the failure.
